hypothesis: Y022's zero radius benefit arose from bijective homes, not evidence that radius-two geometry is universally ineffective. Under frozen non-bijective home collisions at unchanged capacity, larger neighborhoods may rescue Hall-deficient matching.
freeze: Commit preregistration before first experiment workflow creation and execution; never retune collision indices, capacities, thresholds, arms or heldout seeds after observation.
population: Exactly 16 motif keys and 16 circular cells, base home(k)=(7*k+seed) mod16, no added cells/keys. Collision index sequence [(3*seed+5*j) mod16 for j=0..3].
arms: four_collision: all four indexed keys share first selected key's home
two_pairs: selected index 1 shares selected 0's home, selected 3 shares selected 2's home
metric: Maximum bipartite matching cardinality and deficiency 16-cardinality; signed radius-two minus radius-one effect by seed and arm.
primary_interpretation: Classify RADIUS_TWO_RESCUE if at least one non-bijective heldout arm has a positive radius-two margin, NO_RESCUE if all margins zero, MIXED when improvements coexist with persistent deficiency. All negative outcomes preserved.
invalid: Any oracle mismatch, nonmonotonicity, mismatched capacity, source drift, or determinism violation.
validation: Exact frozen predecessor and parent, first-use result artifact, independent augmenting-path and residual-flow matching solvers, one full project regression.
claim_limit: Synthetic collision geometry only; not Y021 R016 original data, learned memory, or autonomous developmental repair.
